method: Mandatory 10/10 final sweep covering current-law/current-plan status, application documents, fee currentness, concept/future-law signals, and cross-municipality contamination.

records.retest: Beleidsregel Woningsplitsing Geertruidenberg 2025 remains current from 01-07-2025 and still requires an omgevingsvergunning for woningsplitsing, with minimum 50 m2 GBO per resulting dwelling and the previously recorded liveability/parking/Bbl/participation framework. No conflicting newer generic instrument was found.
remainingAllowedOnly: ordinary room-rental/hospita outcome under current/integrated plan

records.retest: Delegatiebesluit Geldrop-Mierlo 2026 remains current from 10-06-2026 and replaces older delegation instruments. Current regulatory index also confirms 2026 provincial voorbeschermingsregels as legally integrated into the Omgevingsplan. No separate current municipality-wide room-rental/splitting policy was positively found, so actual permission remains address/current-plan specific rather than an unresolved generic gap.

The 2026 bijwoning policy remains the current positive policy signal and explicitly distinguishes bijwoning from woningsplitsing/perceelsplitsing. No safe newer generic ordinary room-rental/splitting instrument was found. Bibob risk classification for commercial room-rental/labour-migrant accommodation remains a separate screening signal, not substantive permission law.
remainingAllowedOnly: address/current-plan outcome for ordinary splitting/room rental

records.retest: Material currentness improvement: Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Gennep 2026 is adopted and effective from 01-07-2026 through 30-06-2030, with a first amendment also effective from 01-07-2026. This regulation concerns housing allocation/huisvestingsvergunning and is not misrepresented as the substantive room-rental/splitting permit framework. The current municipal room-rental page still states room-by-room letting generally requires municipal consent/permit or spatial permission. The prior house-number package for splitting remains valid.
remainingAllowedOnly: current detailed room-rental policy text/successor if positively exposed

records.retest: Programma wonen remains current and still explicitly orders preparation of an afwegingskader for woningsplitsing/verkamering. No formally adopted detailed afwegingskader was positively found in the final sweep. Current 2026 BOPA/participation and leges governance remain controlling in the interim.

records.retest: Omgevingsvisie Goeree-Overflakkee remains current from 11-02-2026 and explicitly provides the strategic basis for future translation of housing ambitions into Omgevingsplan rules. Existing current BOPA policy/application route remains valid. Previously displayed concept-request fee bands are still not promoted to definitive 2026 fees without current tariff-table proof.

The distinct official Omgevingsloket application channels for room-rental withdrawal/onttrekking, woning splitsen and splitsingsvergunning remain confirmed. A final current official-source sweep still did not surface a stable current municipality-wide substantive housing-stock instrument suitable for safe generic encoding. Remaining legal outcome is therefore address/current-plan/integrated-component dependent.

Current Omgevingsplan is confirmed effective from 13-02-2026 and current Participatiebeleid Omgevingswet 2026 is effective from 19-06-2026 with retroactive effect from 09-06-2026. This updates the participation layer and confirms that older 2024 participation rules are superseded. The full current concept-request document package and EUR 625.25 fee remain part of the application record. The 2015 room-rental policy is not promoted to current law absent positive current publication.
remainingAllowedOnly: successor/currentness of 2015 room-rental policy if later positively published

records.retest: Current 2026 splitsingsvergunning fee remains EUR 1,343 per dwelling/apartment/unit with maximum EUR 26,947 under the positively verified 2026 leges regulation. The current Omgevingsplan version remains confirmed. No stale 2025 fee is used.
remainingAllowedOnly: ordinary room-rental/omzetting current-plan outcome and documents
